instructions: This template is intentionally blocked until measured metadata and explicit verification are supplied.
Image and mask paths are relative to this JSON file; use four distinct registered RGB images and a nonempty single-channel mask of identical spatial size.
Fill light_directions with measured 4x3 vectors in F, B, L, R order and the declared coordinate frame. Geometry must have rank 3; vectors are normalized to unit length.
Fill light_intensities with measured positive 4x3 RGB intensities in F, B, L, R order, consistent with the observation exposure and channel response.
Declare image_linearity as linear or srgb; integer RGB inputs are normalized by dtype full scale and floating inputs must be in [0,1].
Set registration_verified and calibrated true only after verification; this script does not register, resize or infer lighting.
Ambient subtraction is not implemented. Supply already ambient-corrected or ambient-negligible observations; leave ambient_path null.
Relative height is in pixel units, not metric metrology. No ground truth, label or train/test split is required or inferred.
